parsed.rationale: There are QS complexes in V1-V3 with convex ST elevation of about 2-3 mm and prominent T waves in V1-V4, which points to an acute anterior STEMI rather than an old MI with persistent ST elevation (LV aneurysm), although that cannot be fully excluded without clinical correlation and serial ECGs/troponin.
